info.name: 📍 Customer Addresses
info.description:
## 📍 Customer Address Management

Manage shipping and billing addresses for customers.

### 📋 Available Endpoints

- **Create Shipping Address**: Add a new shipping address
- **Create Billing Address**: Add a new billing address
- **Get Shipping Addresses**: List all shipping addresses
- **Get Billing Addresses**: List all billing addresses
- **Set Default Shipping**: Mark an address as default shipping
- **Set Default Billing**: Mark an address as default billing
- **Delete Address**: Remove an address

### 🔒 Authentication

All endpoints require:
- access_token cookie (sent automatically after login)
- Authenticated user (addresses are user-specific)

### 📝 Notes

- Customers can have multiple addresses of each type
- Only one address can be marked as default per type
- Addresses are optional during registration but required for shipping orders
- Billing address is required after trial period expires

item.name: Create Shipping Address
item.description:
## 📦 Create Shipping Address

Add a new shipping address for the authenticated customer.

### 📥 Request Body

```json
{
  "name": "Home",
  "fullAddress": "123 Main St, New York, NY 10001",
  "addressReference": "Apartment 4B",
  "addressType": "shipping",
  "isDefaultShipping": true,
  "coordinates": {
    "latitude": 40.7128,
    "longitude": -74.0060
  }
}
```

### ✅ Success Response (201 Created)

Returns the created address with all details including ID and timestamps.

request.description: Create a new shipping address for the authenticated customer

item.name: Get Shipping Addresses
item.description:
## 📦 Get Shipping Addresses

Get all shipping addresses for the authenticated customer.

### ✅ Success Response (200 OK)

Returns an array of shipping addresses, ordered by default first, then by creation date.

item.name: Delete Address
item.description:
## 🗑️ Delete Address

Delete an address belonging to the authenticated customer.

### ✅ Success Response (204 No Content)

### ⚠️ Note

The address will be permanently deleted. Make sure it's not the only required address before deleting.
